page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated compute resources and high-performance graphics acceleration. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

For hardware acceleration, the ecs.gn9gc.4xlarge includes a single NVIDIA Blackwell GPU equipped with 72 GB of dedicated VRAM. This configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Given the combination of dedicated AMD EPYC processing cores, 128.0 GB of system memory, and a high-capacity NVIDIA Blackwell GPU, this instance is structured for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science, and GPU-accelerated compute tasks. The absence of local storage requires architectural planning around network-attached storage performance.
